name: prego
description: Automated UX, UI and accessibility audit tool

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "NODE_ENV=development npm run dev -w @prego/server" "npm run dev -w @prego/web"
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/server && npm run build -w @prego/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @prego/web
scripts.postinstall: patch-package && playwright install chromium firefox webkit
